# Knowledge-Core-Web: Conventions

## `conventions.code-style`

Status: `verified`

Use strict TypeScript and ESLint; validate with Vitest, Playwright, build, and Storybook. Keep Gateway access server-side and never expose tokens to clients.

Sources: `user-confirmed`

## `security.secrets-and-config`

Status: `verified`

Inject secrets through GitHub or Kubernetes Secrets only; do not commit plaintext secrets. Authentication cookies are HttpOnly, Secure, and use appropriate SameSite; logs must not contain tokens or sensitive data.

Sources: `user-confirmed`
